methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched directly for each vendor on 2026-06-18: docparser.com/pricing/, nanonets.com/pricing/, parseur.com/pricing, veryfi.com/pricing/, mindee.com/pricing, docsumo.com/pricing, rossum.ai/pricing/, hypatos.ai/pricing, and klippa.com/en/dochorizon/. Compliance was corroborated via vendor security pages (docparser.com/security/, veryfi.com/hipaa/, rossum.ai/.../security-and-trust/, hypatos.ai/security) and web search. Adversarial corrections this pass: Docsumo HIPAA and Rossum HIPAA were claimed true but are NOT stated on any official page (Docsumo asserts SOC2 Type 1 + GDPR only; Rossum asserts ISO 27001:2022 + ISO 42001:2023 + SOC2 Type II + TX-RAMP + GDPR/CCPA, no HIPAA) -> both set to null. Mindee publishes EUR only (no USD), so monthlyUsd is null with EUR noted. Parseur Base/Scale and Docsumo/Rossum/Nanonets-Growth paid tiers are genuinely quote-gated -> monthlyUsd null (no guesses). Klippa DocHorizon now renders under 'Doxis AI.dp' branding after acquisition; it publishes no self-serve tiers and a EUR25 one-time free API credit (corroborated via current third-party listings, not shown on the product page). Rossum publishes only a Starter floor of $18,000/year. accessedAt 2026-06-18.
